svg.title: How I test agent work
svg.desc: Illustration, not a recording or a result. Title: How I test agent work. Same task. Isolated runs. Independent checks. On a dark background the Tentaflake mark, a symmetric cluster of blue crystals, hovers over a small lit plinth and stands for the harness. One blue line runs from the plinth to each of four identical dark agents. Every agent stands on its own separate platform, marked with a drawing of its isolated Linux network: a client, a router, a firewall, one open service and one blocked service. No line joins two agents. On the right a golden eye, the independent evaluator, floats apart from the harness with no blue line to it; an amber ring on each network marks what it inspects.
